intro:

With easy-to-learn controls and a focus on competitive gameplay, 2 Players Tanks is perfect for anyone looking for a fun and challenging experience.

The game is played in a closed arena, where two players control their tanks using the keyboard or mouse controls. The first player uses the WASD keys to move and the Q key to shoot, while the second player uses the directional arrows to move and the M key to shoot. The goal is simple: eliminate the opponent's tank and earn 10 points. Every time a player destroys the opponent's tank, they earn a point. The game continues until one of the players reaches 10 points.

What makes 2 Players Tanks stand out is its focus on competitive gameplay. The game is designed specifically for two players, which makes it an incredibly immersive experience. You'll need to be on your toes at all times, constantly thinking about your next move and how to outmaneuver your opponent.
